crm.h1: Everything your customers need from you, done from one app.
crm.sub: Answer the call, send the estimate, text the invoice, get paid on the customer's phone and ask for the review. It all happens in one place, for one monthly price.

benefit_groups.title: Never miss a job
benefit_groups.intro: Most work starts with a phone call. The CRM makes sure that call goes somewhere, even when your hands are full or the shop is closed.

benefits.title: An AI receptionist that answers and books
benefits.body: It picks up when you can't, takes the caller's details and puts the job on your calendar. You find a booked job in the morning instead of a voicemail.

benefits.title: Missed calls get a text back
benefits.body: If a call still slips by, the caller gets a text from your business right away, before they try the next company on the list.

benefits.title: Calls and texts on your own number
benefits.body: Call and text customers from the app on the number you already have, or we set you up with a new one. Each line is $50 a month and covers normal use.

benefits.title: A chatbot on your website
benefits.body: We add an AI chatbot to the website you have now, so visitors can get answers after hours too.

benefit_groups.title: Get paid from the customer's phone
benefit_groups.intro: Paper invoices and "I'll mail a check" slow everything down. Here the invoice goes out by text and the customer pays from the same link.

benefits.title: Invoices by text
benefits.body: Send the invoice the minute the work is done. It goes to the customer's phone as a text with a link.

benefits.title: Customers pay by card from their phone
benefits.body: They tap the link, enter a card and they're done. Nobody has to call the office or find a stamp.

benefits.title: Card payments in the same app
benefits.body: Payments land next to the job and the customer record, so you can see what's paid and what's still owed without opening another program.

benefit_groups.title: Estimates people can read
benefit_groups.intro: A quote on the back of a business card gets lost. A clear estimate in the customer's texts doesn't.

benefits.title: Send estimates by text
benefits.body: Build the estimate from the customer's record and text it before you leave. They read it on their phone, line by line.

benefits.title: A customer hub for every customer
benefits.body: Each customer gets one link where they can see their estimates and invoices, so they don't have to call and ask.

benefits.title: See which estimates are still open
benefits.body: Open estimates stay in front of you with a follow-up reminder, so a big quote doesn't sit for a week while everyone forgets about it.

benefit_groups.title: Everything in one place
benefit_groups.intro: Customer details, open quotes and who to call back usually live in five places. The CRM puts them in one.

benefits.title: One customer list the business keeps
benefits.body: Names, numbers, notes and past jobs sit in one list. When someone calls back a year later, you know who they are and what you did for them. If an employee leaves, the list stays with the business.

benefits.title: A pipeline you can see
benefits.body: Every new lead and open quote sits on one board, from the first call to the booked job. You can see what's waiting on you and what's waiting on the customer.

benefits.title: Follow-up reminders
benefits.body: Put a reminder on any lead or quote. When it's time to call back, the CRM tells you or whoever owns that lead.

benefits.title: Your whole team on the same page
benefits.body: Up to 10 people use it for $99 a month. Everyone works from the same list, the same pipeline and the same schedule.

benefit_groups.title: One schedule board
benefit_groups.intro: When the office and the crew look at the same schedule, nobody has to call around to find out who's where.

benefits.title: A dispatch board for the day
benefits.body: See which job goes to which person, and when, on one board. Move a job and everyone sees the change.

benefits.title: On-my-way texts in one tap
benefits.body: Your tech taps once and the customer gets a text that someone is on the way. That's one less "when are you coming?" call to the office.

benefit_groups.title: Customers book themselves
benefit_groups.intro: Plenty of people would rather book at 10pm than call at 10am. Let them.

benefits.title: Online booking
benefits.body: Customers pick a time from your real calendar, day or night, and the booking shows up in the CRM.

benefits.title: Website forms that feed the CRM
benefits.body: Every request sent from a Top Shelf website goes straight into your CRM, so it's waiting for you instead of sitting in an inbox.

benefit_groups.title: More reviews
benefit_groups.intro: Happy customers forget to leave a review unless someone asks while the job is still fresh.

benefits.title: One tap after every job
benefits.body: Tap once and your review link goes to the customer by text. It takes a few seconds, so it actually gets done.

benefits.title: See who has been asked
benefits.body: You can see who got a request and who left a review, and write your replies in the app.

benefit_groups.title: Built around your trade
benefit_groups.intro: A dentist's day and a roofer's day look nothing alike, so the CRM shouldn't look the same for both.

benefits.title: Layouts that fit how you work
benefits.body: We can change the layout and screens to match your business, or build a custom CRM for your industry. Either way it's the same $99 a month for up to 10 users.

faq.q: What happens when I tap Try the CRM?
faq.a: You fill out a short form. We call you, then send you a demo of the CRM.

faq.q: Is there a free trial?
faq.a: Instead of a trial you set up yourself, we call you and walk you through a demo built around how your business works. Tap Try the CRM to start.

faq.q: Is there a contract?
faq.a: No. The plan is month to month, and you can stop whenever you want.

faq.q: Is there a setup fee?
faq.a: No. There is no setup fee.

faq.q: How much does it cost?
faq.a: The Signature plan is $99 a month for 1 to 10 users and $199 a month for 11 to 25 users. For 26 users or more, call us for pricing.

faq.q: Do you charge per user?
faq.a: No. It's one price for up to 10 users. Everyone on your team gets the whole CRM.

faq.q: Which plan do I need?
faq.a: There is one plan, and the price goes by how many people use it. If your team grows past 10, you move to the 11 to 25 price.

faq.q: What's the true total cost? Are there other charges?
faq.a: The plan, plus $50 a month for each phone line. A line covers normal use, and usage above that is billed. We go over what heavier use costs on your demo call. A website is optional and costs $499 one time.

faq.q: Can I keep my business number?
faq.a: Yes. You can use the number you have now, or we set you up with a new one. Each line is $50 a month.

faq.q: How long does setup take?
faq.a: It depends on your business and what you need set up. We go over that on your demo call.

faq.q: Who sets it up?
faq.a: We call you and walk through how your business runs. We go over exactly what we set up for you on your demo call.

faq.q: Can I bring my customer list over?
faq.a: We go over how to bring in the customers you have now on your demo call.

faq.q: Who owns my data, and can I export it?
faq.a: We go over how your data comes in and goes out on your demo call.

faq.q: Can customers pay from their phone?
faq.a: Yes. You text the invoice, and they pay by card from the link.

faq.q: What do card payments cost?
faq.a: We go over the card rate on your demo call, so you know the number before you sign up.

faq.q: When do I get paid after a customer pays by card?
faq.a: We go over payout timing on your demo call.

faq.q: Can I send estimates?
faq.a: Yes. You build the estimate from the customer's record and send it by text. The customer reads it on their phone and can find it again in their customer hub.

faq.q: Does it answer the phone when I'm busy?
faq.a: Yes. The AI receptionist answers and books the job. If a call still slips by, the caller gets a text back right away.

faq.q: Does it get me more reviews?
faq.a: One tap after every job texts your review link to the customer. You can see who has been asked and who left a review.

faq.q: Does it work on my phone?
faq.a: Your customers do their part from a phone: booking, reading estimates and paying invoices by text. Your crew can send on-my-way texts and invoices from the field. We show you how it looks on your own phone during the demo call.

faq.q: Do my techs only see their own jobs?
faq.a: We go over who on your team sees what on your demo call.

faq.q: Does it connect to QuickBooks?
faq.a: Ask us on your demo call and we'll tell you straight how it fits with what you use for your books.

faq.q: Is it available in Spanish?
faq.a: We go over that on your demo call.

faq.q: Will it fit my industry?
faq.a: Yes. We can change the layout and screens to fit how you work, or build a custom CRM for your industry. It's the same $99 a month for up to 10 users.

faq.q: Do I need a new website to use the CRM?
faq.a: No. The CRM works with the website you have now, and the plan adds an AI chatbot to it. If you want a new site, it's $499 one time.

faq.q: Can you add a chatbot to the website I already have?
faq.a: Yes. An AI chatbot for your current website is part of the Signature plan.

faq.q: Who helps me if I get stuck?
faq.a: Call or text us at (469) 833-3033. That's a local number. We go over support hours on your demo call.

closing.h: See it running on your business.
closing.body: Tell us a little about what you do and how big your team is. We call you, walk through it, then send you a demo.

faq.q: How much does a website cost, and what's included?
faq.a: $499 one time. That covers a custom design built by us that works on any phone, a site built so Google can read it, a contact and booking form that feeds the CRM, and a logo if you need one.

faq.q: Is the website part of the Signature plan?
faq.a: No. It's a separate one-time purchase, and you don't need the plan to buy it.

faq.q: Do I need a new website to use the CRM?
faq.a: No. The plan adds an AI chatbot to the website you have now. The $499 site is there if you want a new one.

faq.q: Is there a monthly fee for the website?
faq.a: No. The website is $499, paid once.

faq.q: Do you do ongoing SEO?
faq.a: No. The site is built so Google can read it: clear titles, descriptions, headings and structure. That's part of the build, not an ongoing service.

faq.q: How long does it take to build?

faq.q: Who handles the domain and hosting?
faq.a: We go over the domain and hosting for your site on your call.

faq.q: Can I see examples?
faq.a: Yes. The sample sites on this page are made-up businesses we built to show the kind of work we do, each paired with a sample CRM.

faq.q: How do I get started?
faq.a: Tap Try the CRM or call or text (469) 833-3033 and tell us you want a website. We call you to talk it through.

closing.body: Tell us about your business and what you want the site to do. We call you to talk it through, and we can show you the CRM while we're at it.
